item.title: Utilities outline plan to move water from Indianapolis reservoir to Boone County tech hub
item.description: Citizens Energy Group and Lebanon Utilities publicly presented their plan to divert water from Eagle Creek Reservoir to a Boone County technology hub to the Indianapolis City-County Council committee and local residents. Plans call for the water to go to the LEAP District.

item.title: Watch: One-on-one with Adam Vinatieri after his election to Hall of Fame
item.description: Colts legend Adam Vinatieri has been elected into the Pro Football Hall of Fame. Vinatieri is the NFL's all-time points leader.

item.title: 20-year-old sentenced to 45 years for murder outside Indianapolis party
item.description: Kyis Glasper, 20, was sentenced to 45 years in prison for the June 2024 murder of Kiyon Davidson, 21, at a west-side apartment complex, while Dewan Jackson, 20, awaits trial for his alleged involvement in the same shooting.

item.title: ICE takes custody of semi driver after Jay County crash kills 4
item.description: Bekzhan Beishekeev, 30, was taken into custody by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement after he was involved in a head-on collision in Jay County, Indiana, that killed four people. The White House and Ice say he was paroled into the U.S. after illegally entering from Kyrgyzstan.

item.title: IMPD arrests fourth person in sex-trafficking case
item.description: Four people have been arrested in connection with a sex-trafficking ring in Indianapolis, resulting in two young women being rescued by authorities.

item.title: Trump administration launches TrumpRx website for discounted drugs
item.description: The Trump administration is launching TrumpRx, a website that will help patients buy prescription drugs directly from manufacturers at a discounted rate, in an effort to lower drug prices for Americans.

item.title: Indianapolis student’s stop-motion video on kindness wins national contest
item.description: Bea Blettner, a seventh grader at Harshman Middle School in Indianapolis, earned second place in a national video contest about kindness with her stop-motion Claymation video, which encourages people to be kind to each other.

item.title: Purdue legend Drew Brees elected to Pro Football Hall of Fame
item.description: Drew Brees, former Purdue quarterback and 13-time Pro Bowler, has been elected to the Pro Football Hall of Fame after 20 years in the NFL, 15 of them with the New Orleans Saints, and leading the NFL in passing yards seven times.

item.title: Colts legend Adam Vinatieri elected to Pro Football Hall of Fame
item.description: Adam Vinatieri, a four-time Super Bowl winner and NFL all-time leader in field goals made, has been selected to the Pro Football Hall of Fame in his second year as a finalist.
